@name: Layman
@slug: layman
@source: character_law
@realms: Mentalism
@prime_stats: -
@description:
 Normally each character has an "adventuring" profession, reflecting how his
 early training and life have moulded his thought patterns. However, the
 Layman profession represents characters who do not have a standard
 "adventuring" profession. Most non-adventuring NPCs will have the Layman
 profession. Every Layman should select an occupation. The GM should move
 skills to the Everyman and Occupational categories as is appropriate to the
 occupation. For example, a Layman (Blacksmith) should probably have
 Metal-crafting (smithing) and Evaluate Metal as Occupational skills. In
 addition, he might get Metal Lore, Evalutate Armor, and Evaluate Weapon as
 Everyman skills.
